purpose: Teach: 建材/渡米/前月/スペシャリスト/リコール/各所/積む/段ボール

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規プロジェクト、本気で、絶対、建材、絶対、エコ素材、絶対、検討しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we thoroughly examine eco-friendly building materials for the new project.
lines.style: Measured, purposeful opening. Clear enunciation on key terms. Steady pace conveying genuine commitment. Slight pause before 'eco-friendly' — the emphasis lands there.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。次月の渡米、本気で、絶対、ビザ申請、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the visa application for next month's trip to the States. Thank you for handling that.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly formal. Clipped efficiency at the start. Warmth emerges on 'thank you' — genuine appreciation, not perfunctory. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 前月の売上、本気で、絶対、好調、絶対、続いてるわね
lines.en: Last month's sales figures have held strong, haven't they.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Reflective pause on the opening. Conversational lift at the end — inviting agreement, not asserting. Confident but not self-congratulatory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規スペシャリスト、本気で、絶対、採用、絶対、決定しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've decided to hire the new specialist. I appreciate your work on that.
lines.style: Declarative opening. Straightforward, no hedging. The appreciation lands warmly but briefly — respect shown through efficiency, not elaboration.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: リコール対応、本気で、絶対、各部署、絶対、共有、絶対、徹底しましょう
lines.en: We need to make sure every department is aligned on the recall response. Let's be thorough about this.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Firm weight on 'every department' and 'thorough.' Slightly slower pace — the stakes are clear. No room for misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各所からの、本気で、絶対、ご意見、絶対、収集、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively gathering feedback from all the relevant departments. Thank you for your attention to this.
lines.style: Engaged, detail-oriented. Slight emphasis on 'actively gathering' — showing movement. Closes with genuine appreciation, warm but professional.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 倉庫、本気で、絶対、商品を、絶対、整然と、絶対、積むよう、絶対、お願いね
lines.en: I'd like to ask that everything in the warehouse be stacked neatly and organized. Thank you.
lines.style: Polite but clear directive. Gentle opening, then crisp specificity on 'neatly and organized.' The request carries weight — tidiness matters here. Closing 'thank you' is warm, not forced.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。段ボール、本気で、絶対、リサイクル可能なもの、絶対、選定しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making sure to select recyclable cardboard wherever possible. Thank you for that guidance.
lines.style: Committed follow-through. Steady pace, deliberate on 'recyclable.' Closing gratitude is genuine — this person appreciates being asked to do the right thing.
